# Zuvigo

> Websites, applications and software that make business work better.

Zuvigo builds modern websites, custom web applications, cloud and desktop software, business automation, and productivity tools for growing businesses — through one accountable technology team.

## Core Capabilities

- **Custom Website Design & Web Applications**: Modern, responsive, high-performance web applications, customer portals, and landing pages designed for conversion and speed.
- **Cloud & Desktop Software**: Practical document tools, offline-first desktop apps, and private-cloud deployments for teams that need control and reliability.
- **Business & AI Automation**: Production-grade AI chat and voice agents, automated lead follow-ups, document processing, and multi-tool workflow automations.
- **Tech Partner For Founders**: Turn ideas into working first-version products (MVPs), milestone-based development, and launch support.

- [Homepage](https://zuvigo.com/): Overview of Zuvigo solutions and software.
- [Solutions](https://zuvigo.com/solutions): Websites, web applications, cloud & desktop software, and business & AI automation.
- [Software](https://zuvigo.com/software): VigoPDF, eSign, VigoFlow, VigoLetters, Productivity Suite, and Desktop Software.
- [Services](https://zuvigo.com/services): End-to-end custom digital solutions (alias of Solutions).
- [For Founders](https://zuvigo.com/for-founders): MVP development, milestone-based delivery, and launch support for startups.
- [Contact & Discovery Call](https://zuvigo.com/contact): Schedule a free discovery call and get a clear project estimate.
- [Insights & Blog](https://zuvigo.com/blog): Articles and guides on web, CRM, software, and AI.
- [Full Blog Articles](https://blog.zuvigo.com/): Long-form articles and engineering case studies.
- [Sitemap](https://zuvigo.com/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable XML sitemap.

## Software Products

- [VigoPDF](https://pdf.zuvigo.com/): Document editing and PDF workflows.
- [Productivity Workspace](https://pdf.zuvigo.com/workspace): Unified productivity suite.
- [eSign](https://pdf.zuvigo.com/esign): Digital signatures and contracts.
- [VigoLetters](https://pdf.zuvigo.com/letters): Letter and document automation.
- [VigoFlow](https://pdf.zuvigo.com/diagrams): Diagrams and workflow tooling.
- [Web Reports](https://pdf.zuvigo.com/webreports): Reporting for modern teams.
- [Enterprise](https://pdf.zuvigo.com/enterprise): Private-cloud and enterprise deployments.
- [Desktop Software](https://pdf.zuvigo.com/desktop): Offline-first desktop applications.
